data.one_liner: Command-line tool and library to check for unused and missing dependencies in Flutter or Dart projects.
data.what_it_does: Analyzes project source files and pubspec.yaml to identify unused dependencies, unused dev dependencies, and missing dependencies. Can be used via CLI or programmatically in Dart code.
use_when: You want to clean up unused dependencies in your pubspec.yaml
You need to detect missing dependencies imported in source files but not declared
You want to check dependency health in continuous integration (CI) pipelines
avoid_when: Your project relies heavily on runtime-only packages that have no importable API
strengths: Supports both CLI and programmatic usage
Can fail builds in CI using the --fail-on-issues flag
Provides JSON and summary output formats for automation
weaknesses: Detection is import-based and may flag packages with no importable API as unused
Only scans the lib folder by default unless additional folders are specified
data.setup_notes: Install globally via 'dart pub global activate dart_depcheck' or add it as a dependency in your project.
